title: introduce-multi-tenant-invocation-sankey-and-sampled-kv-hitmap
author: Priya Menon
description: Motivation: long-tail tenant-level cost attribution and routing decisions are hard to reason about from point metrics alone. We prototype a Sankey-style invocation-flow visualization that links per-invocation stages (ingest->routing->model->postprocess) to sampled KV cache hit/miss patterns so product, SRE and billing teams can quickly surface which stage and tenant-shard combinations drive disproportionate token cost. Summary: adds an opt-in runtime flag to sample invocation flows and correlated KV cache signals; a low-overhead exporter that emits aggregated Sankey edges with weight and cost buckets; a Grafana dashboard with a Sankey panel and a complementary KV hitmap heatmap; alerting guidance and a staged rollout plan. Implementation details: 1) telemetry/exporter/kv_sampler.go implements a reservoir-based sampler keyed by (tenant_id,invocation_role,tenant_shard) and emits edge tuples (src_stage,dst_stage,weight,cost_tokens,kv_hit_mode) to the metrics pipeline with cardinality controls; 2) runtime/flags.go adds enable_observability_sankey and sankey_sample_rate (default off, 0.001 sample rate) with per-tenant override hooks; 3) metrics/transformer normalizes edge labels and buckets costs into [tiny,small,medium,large] to keep metrics cardinality bounded; 4) grafana/dashboards/tenant_sankey.json defines the Sankey panel with drilldown links to traces and a KV hitmap heatmap panel; 5) docs/observability/multi-tenant-sankey.md documents signal semantics, sampling lottery, and alert tuning recommendations. Rollout: feature gated; start with 25% of tenants for 48h, evaluate exporter CPU/ingest, increase to 100% after SLO verification. Backward compatibility: metrics are emitted under new metric namespaces (redwood.sankey.edge, redwood.sankey.kv_heat) and default sampling is off so no impact to existing dashboards. Checklist: ( ) unit tests added for sampler reservoir; (x) integration test asserting downstream aggregation; (x) grafana dashboard created and stored as code; (x) docs updated; (x) CI green; (x) rollout plan included. Observability impact: estimated additional exporter CPU ~+2% when enabled for sampled tenants; ingestion volume increase estimated at +0.5% of metrics cardinality at 0.1% global sampling. Related: follows ENG-1589 ideas about attribution; complements existing token-cost rollups by providing a flow-based view of where tokens are consumed and whether KV behavior correlates with cost spikes.
commits: 4 commits: initial sampler implementation and tests; add runtime flags and per-tenant override; dashboard and docs; fix: reduce label cardinality by bucketing tenant_shard to coarse groups
changes: High-level changed files: telemetry/exporter/kv_sampler.go (new), runtime/flags.go (mod), metrics/transformer.go (mod), grafana/dashboards/tenant_sankey.json (new), docs/observability/multi-tenant-sankey.md (new), tests/integration/sankey_integration_test.go (new), ci/workflows/observability.yml (mod)
review_thread: Ethan Zhao: 'Can we bound the cardinality of tenant_shard to avoid prometheus explosion?' Author reply: 'Yes, transformer buckets shard -> shard_group (16 groups) and we documented it; added unit test covering bucket mapping.' Marta Ruiz: 'Need explicit guidance on alert tuning for Sankey-derived attributions; someone might double count cost if they create alerts on both edge weight and token buckets.' Author reply: 'Added Alerting section in docs: recommend using composite SLOs and stable-signature thresholds, and suggested suppression window of 30m for transient bursts.' Samir Patel: 'CI flaky: sankey_integration_test failed on first run due to race in sampler reservoir; please add deterministic seed for test.' Author reply: 'Added seeding and retry in test; re-ran CI.' Reviewer approvals: Ethan approved after comments addressed; Marta approved; Samir approved after test fix.
ci_checks: CI pipeline: build (passed), unit-tests (passed), integration-tests (initially failed on sankey_integration_test, rerun passed), lint (passed), metrics-lint (passed), grafana-schema-check (passed). Notes: integration flaky test observed once - fixed by deterministic seeding and small mutex in sampler; full suite green on rerun.
release_notes: Add optional multi-tenant invocation Sankey visualization and sampled KV hitmap to improve cost attribution and debugging. Feature is off-by-default and controlled via runtime flags. Provides a low-overhead path for teams to surface stage-level cost drivers and KV behavior. Rollout plan included.
performance_impact: Estimated exporter CPU +2% for sampled tenants; metrics ingestion +0.5% at 0.1% global sampling; default off.
operational_runbook: If exporter CPU or metrics ingest spikes above threshold during rollout: 1) disable enable_observability_sankey globally, 2) revert to previous exporter image, 3) re-evaluate sample rate and shard bucketing, 4) contact telemetry-oncall (pager duty), 5) post-mortem if incident caused customer impact.
testing: Unit tests for sampler reservoir and bucketing; deterministic seeding for integration; local grafana schema validation; manual e2e run against staging cluster with 10k synthetic invocations to verify Sankey edge distribution and heatmap coherence.
